lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in discrete horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, beginning posterior to the gills and extending toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Narrow vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like structural pattern on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features on the dorsal third of the flank characterized by a distinct luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge and lower intensity shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density cluster of high-luminance spots distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, dark, irregular mark of low pixel intensity on the ventral lobe of the caudal fin, contrasting sharply with the surrounding tissue luminance.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small teleost silhouettes (remoras) visible in close proximity to the ventral midline and pectoral fins.
